app_description_summary: Developer materials describe Woebot as a relational-agent app that delivers self-help content derived from CBT and related therapeutic approaches through a structured, choose-your-own-adventure style chat interface
ai_claim_summary: Developer materials describe Woebot as an automated conversational agent; the developer's own technology-overview page states conversations are written by conversational writers in collaboration with clinical experts, which is a narrower characterization than generative AI
primary_claims: Developer describes Woebot as helping users manage symptoms of depression and anxiety and build emotional resilience through CBT-based self-help exercises
target_population: Not explicitly specified beyond general adult self-help users in sources examined

app_description_summary: Developer materials describe Wysa as an AI-powered mental wellbeing chatbot combining mood tracking, CBT/DBT-based self-help tools, and optional human coach support
ai_claim_summary: Apple App Store listing explicitly states: "Wysa is an emotionally intelligent chatbot that uses AI to react to the emotions you express"
primary_claims: Developer describes Wysa as helping users manage stress, anxiety, depression, and sleep through structured self-help conversations and mindfulness content
target_population: Developer states users must be at least 18, with a supervised pathway described for ages 13-18

target_population: Developer states Youper is intended for users aged 18 and older and is not designed or intended for minors
